headline: Sunil Vachani and Atul B. Lall re-appointed for 5-year terms
why: Continuity of core leadership as Whole Time Director and MD for another five years starting May 2027.

people.name: Sunil Vachani
people.background: Over three decades of experience in the EMS industry. Associated with the Company since its inception and under his reins, the Company has been adjudged as one of the leading Indian EMS.
